canonical.usage: response.usageMetadata (cumulative across frames: promptTokenCount / candidatesTokenCount / thoughtsTokenCount / cachedContentTokenCount / totalTokenCount)

notes: Antigravity's wire: POST https://cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com/v1internal:streamGenerateContent?alt=sse, served by route 'own' (see lib/presets.js endpoint.protocol). The provider streams WHOLE parts rather than deltas — a frame carries a full {text} or a complete functionCall — so the adapter owns block start/delta/end indexing and the descriptor is toolCallShape 'complete' (no fragment ordinals). Two consequences measured 2026-11-05: usageMetadata is CUMULATIVE across frames (never sum it), and thoughtsTokenCount sits outside candidatesTokenCount, so the total only reconciles under the prompt+output+reasoning formula. promptTokenCount INCLUDES cache hits, so cachedContentTokenCount must be split out. Reasoning requires thinkingConfig.includeThoughts; effort is encoded in the model id suffix because the server IGNORES generationConfig.thinkingConfig.thinkingLevel. Images ride as inlineData {mimeType, data}, and a model without image support answers UNSUPPORTED_OPTION instead of silently dropping the image. structuredOutput is NOT claimed: this vendor endpoint has no responseSchema/responseMimeType path in the adapter, and no measurement supports it. cache here means cache-token REPORTING (cachedContentTokenCount); no cache write/control is sent.
